question: What is the meaning of bci in relation to official (mandated) indicators and certificates?
description: Building Certification and Assessment (BCA) Index is a measure used to evaluate and certify the quality of buildings through objective third-party verification. It allows for objective comparisons between buildings and serves as a marketing tool. The BCA Index is part of various certification systems worldwide that focus on assessing and certifying sustainable buildings based on specific criteria and indicators.
